svg.text: S4 SEARCH SPACE | DISCO + ROOTED-TRIPLET GUIDE
Candidate trees are single-copy proxies; the final objective is scored only on the original rooted/tagged multicopy genes.
FROM ROOTED/TAGGED MULTICOPY GENES TO SINGLE-COPY DISCO COMPONENTS
A occurs on both sides; other copies may recur.
Input trees stay unchanged for final scoring.
Three smaller rooted trees; each has no more than one leaf per species.
G2 → C4, C5, … (single-copy pieces from its duplication cuts)
G3 → C6, C7, … (components below four leaves are discarded)
ONE TRIPLET-BASED GUIDE MATRIX FEEDS TWO SEARCH-SPACE BRANCHES
Computed from retained DISCO single-copy trees.
This guide matrix is not the final GDL objective.
For each component, record its pre-cut root scope.
Eligible insertions = scope taxa missing after cuts.
For missing x, choose the most similar present
anchor in M; insert x as that leaf's sister.
Completed components are streamed in batches.
Use the SAME M: distance(a,b) = 1 − M[a,b].
Agglomerate all species into one rooted tree.
Its internal rooted clades add candidates.
Guide construction never supplies GDL weights.
WORKED EXAMPLE: WHY COMPLETION IS PARTIAL, NOT GLOBAL
D2 tie → cut right; D1 tie → cut right.
D1 child scopes: L7=7 taxa, R7=7 taxa.
currently present anchor for each x.
CANDIDATE CLADES ENTER STELAR DP; ORIGINAL GENES SUPPLY THE SCORE
Rooted subtree clades from completed DISCO trees
plus rooted clades of the global UPGMA tree.
Partial component-root clades are valid candidates.
Default S4: no S1 input clades; cross-tree
Find the highest triplet-score tree allowed by X.
Weights use original rooted/tagged G1, G2, G3, …
Equivalent triplets at the same gene-tree root
count once; duplication-rooted triplets are ignored.
One rooted species tree is returned.
S4 default = strict-lineage DISCO + rooted-triplet similarity + local DP transitions. Optional --exhaustive and --cross-tree-splits change the search space.
